title: Toxic Metals and Metalloids in Infant Formulas Marketed in Brazil, and Child Health Risks According to the Target Hazard Quotients and Target Cancer Risk
abstract: Aluminum, arsenic, cadmium, tin, mercury, lead, and uranium were investigated in infant formulas marketed in Brazil by ICP-MS, with THQ and TCR calculated to assess potential toxicity risk for children consuming these products continuously. Arsenic showed THQ > 1, indicating potential health concerns for newborns or children.
